_doc.what: Hand-curated repatriations of fallen soldiers' bodies between Russia and Ukraine. Irregular, announced by each side separately — NOT a scrape: this file is edited by hand.
_doc.backfill: Seeded from a chart by the OSINT account creamy_caprice (sources/body-exchanges.png, May 2023 – Oct 2026, no sources given), then checked against RBC article by article. Every figure here is read from a source (an RBC article or a Coordination HQ post, quoted under sources); the chart's own values are kept under `chart_creamy_caprice` for audit. Ukraine's figures were then checked against the Coordination HQ's own posts (t.me/Koord_shtab, read via the public t.me/s preview — no login).

fields.date: Day of the exchange (YYYY-MM-DD), as reported.
fields.ua_received: Bodies returned to Ukraine, as Ukraine's Coordination HQ for the Treatment of POWs posts it (t.me/Koord_shtab). Its posts note the bodies are Ukrainian 'according to the Russian side' until identified.
fields.ru_received: Bodies of Russian servicemen returned to Russia, as the Russian side reports it (Saraliev, Medinsky). null when no figure is known — not the same as 0.
fields.status: confirmed | partial (one side's figure missing) | discrepancy (sources disagree with each other on a stored figure; see notes). A later article misremembering an exchange is noted but does not count.
fields.sources[]: { via, url, published_at, covers, quote } — quote is verbatim (ellipses mark cuts) so the figure can be checked without the page. covers lists what the source supports.
fields.chart_creamy_caprice: The values on creamy_caprice's chart (an OSINT account; sources/body-exchanges.png, May 2023 – Oct 2026, no sources given): { date, ua_received, ru_received }, or null when the exchange is not on the chart. null inside means the label is cut off.
fields.chart_creamy_caprice_discrepancy: How the chart differs from the sourced figures, in words; null when it agrees. Does not affect status.
